info.desc: Like a Virgin is the second studio album by Madonna, released on November 12, 1984, via Sire Records. Following the success of her debut album, Madonna wanted to become the record producer of her next album. However, her label was not ready to give her the artistic freedom and she chose Nile Rodgers instead to produce the album due to his work with David Bowie. Madonna wrote six songs on the record, five of which feature Steve Bray as a co-writer. The album was recorded at Power Station Studio in New York at a quick pace. Rodgers enlisted the help .

podcast.body: Released in 1984, this album is considered one of the most important in music history. It was a massive commercial success, selling immensely and having almost all its tracks released as singles. This album marked the true beginning of Madonna's identity as a provocateur and a feminist figure. Its lyrics, including the title track, "Dress You Up," and "Material Girl," were explicitly combative, feminist, and direct, initiating her era of provocation. "Yo creo que uno de los discos más importantes de la historia de la música."

This album featured the title track which became Madonna's first number one hit, spending six weeks at the top through January 1985. The album was propelled to the number one spot in February 1985, holding for three weeks, largely due to the success and impact of the "Material Girl" video. "Like a Virgin album to number one in February 1985, where it held for three weeks."
